Problem Statement:
A heap can be represented as an array as it is a complete binary tree. The element at heap[i] is the parent of heap[2 i] andheap[2 i + 1]. (i >= 1). Determine if a given array is a min-heap, max-heap or neither.
input_spec: The first line contains an Integer N denoting the number of citizens.The next line contains N space separated integers A[i] (1
output_spec: If the given array is a min-heap print MINIf the given array is a max-heap print MAXPrint NONE if it is neither.
